slug: 2026-05-20 Transforming lives in Benin a unique identification system

systems.owner: Government of Benin and ANIP, supported by the World Bank's WURI project (US$45 million for Benin)
systems.tiers: national; nearly 99% of the population biometrically enrolled and more than 7.7 million people holding an NPI at end May 2025, with more than 6.1 million certificates issued free
its operationalisation is supported by the WURI project; not described

note: A World Bank feature on identity enrolment and the C'est Moi card; it says a quarter of the population once had no birth certificate but states nothing on how births or deaths are registered.
